title: Scrip Asks…What Does 2024 Hold For Biopharma? Part 5: Clinical Trial Trends
summary: Some 50 experts and executives in the biopharma sector shared their views on the major trends they expect to see driving change in the clinical trials arena in 2024. Artificial intelligence applied to clinical development, greater use of remote monitoring and increased patient diversity in trials were key themes.
